1. (Currently amended) A lamp comprised of an at least substantially hollow columnar body, a plurality of light emitting diodes disposed on said columnar body, a plurality of fins disposed on said columnar body, a base member disposed at a first end of the columnar body and providing a means for electrical connection, and an electronics module disposed within the columnar body and in electrical communication with the base member, __wherein the electronics module comprises a printed circuit board including circuitry for converting AC to DC current__.

2. (Previously presented) The lamp of claim 1 wherein a second end of said columnar body is open.

3. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 1 further including __a plurality of__ light dispersing optic element__s__ overlapping said diodes.

4. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim __3__ wherein said optic element__s__ include__s__ a phosphor material.

5. (Previously presented) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said diodes are substantially evenly spaced radially around the columnar body.

6. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 5 wherein said fins are substantially equally disposed between said diodes __such that each fin is positioned at a midpoint between adjacent diodes__.

7. (Previously presented) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said columnar body comprises one of a tetragon, pentagon, hexagon, heptagon, octagon, nonagon, decagon, hendecagon, or dodecagon in cross-section.

8. (Previously presented) The lamp of claim 7 wherein at least one diode resides on each face of said columnar body.

9. (Previously presented) The lamp of claim 8 wherein one fin resides on each corner of said columnar body.

10. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 9 wherein a single diode resides on each face __and wherein each face has a substantially planar surface__.

11. (Previously presented) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said columnar body and said fins are comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 100 W/mK.

12. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 9 including a single optic element __that__ is disposed between each adjacent fin over-lapping said diode __and wherein the optic element comprises a lens having a curved outer surface__.

13. (Previously presented) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said base member comprises an Edison screw base or a wedge base.

14. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said electronics module comprises a printed circuit board including circuitry for converting AC to DC current __and wherein the printed circuit board is positioned within a lower portion of the columnar body adjacent to the base member__.

15. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 3 wherein said optic element__s__ preferentially direct__s__ light substantially perpendicular to an elongated axis of the columnar body __and wherein the optic elements comprise lenses having refractive surfaces__.

16. (Currently amended) A lamp comprising an elongated hollow polygonal body comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 100 W/mK, a fin extending radially from each corner of said body, a light emitting diode mounted to each side of said body, a screw or wedge base connector closing a first end of said body, a second end of said body being open, an electronics module disposed within said body in electrical communication with said connector and said light emitting diodes, said lamp having a general A19 outline, __wherein the electronics module comprises a printed circuit board including circuitry for converting AC to DC current__.

17. (Currently amended) A method of manufacturing a lamp comprising extruding an elongated hollow body, said body comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 100 W/mK, cutting said body to a predetermined length, attaching at least one light emitting diode to said body and providing electrical circuitry suitable for powering said light emitting diode, __wherein the electrical circuitry comprises a printed circuit board including circuitry for converting AC to DC current__.

18. (Previously presented) The method of claim 17 wherein said material has a thermal conductivity greater than about 150 W/mK.

19. (Previously presented) The method of claim 17 wherein said body includes a plurality of integral radially extending fins.

20. (Currently amended) The method of claim __17__ wherein said body has substantially straight side walls.
